title: Āsavakkhaya
text: 2. -āsavānaṃ khayāya {saṃvattanti} || || 3. Katamāni pañca || Saddhindriyaṃ || la-pe || paññindriyaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni saṃyojanānam pahānāya saṃvattanti anusayasamugghātāya saṃvattanti || addhānapariññāya saṃvattantī ti || āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattanti || ||
